newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian lira rises to 1,000/mark, 3-month high.
newsitem.headline: Italian lira rises to 1,000/mark, 3-month high.

text.p: The Italian lira strengthened to touch the 1,000 per mark level for the first time in three months on Wednesday.

The lira, helped by general mark weakness on the crosses and a booming Italian bond market, has not touched the psychological 1,000 per mark barrier since June 25 this year, when it briefly ducked past the line to 998.00.
Before that, the currency has not been stronger than 1,000 since August 31, 1994.
The currency continued to power ahead after breaking the level, to be quoted at 998.30/8.80 per mark by 1727 GMT. It began European trade around 1,008.40.
Against the dollar it was quoted at 1,511.20/1.95.
